data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in EU and URG.

EU reported Q2 2026 revenue of $15.7M versus $3.7M a year earlier (+328.4% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1500881/000162828026056452/0001628280-26-056452-index.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
